description: Ghani Dairies Limited is a corporate dairy farm producing fresh raw milk to what it describes as global standards. It was established in 2020 and converted into a public limited company in 2025, and operates from Rahdari, Noor Pur Thal in District Khushab, under the Ghani Group.
headOffice: 45 – Aurangzeb Block, New Garden Town, Lahore, Pakistan
